caption: The drawing features a rectangular object resembling a shallow box or tray with a round central disk positioned vertically, partially set into the box. The disk appears solid and has visible markings or cracks on its face, suggesting a wood or stone texture. There is a knob or spindle-like structure attached to the center of the disk. The shading and line work create a realistic texture, and the overall color is a range of muted grays and browns, typical of pencil or graphite on a light, off-white or beige background. The object appears to rest alone on the drawing's otherwise empty background, with the artist’s signature, “Pearl Davis,” visible to the right of the object.
title: Coffee Grinder
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
